# TechFiyr

> TechFiyr is a mobile app and web software development agency based in Mirpur DOHS, Dhaka, Bangladesh. We design, build and ship Flutter, React Native, iOS and Android apps, custom web software and SaaS platforms, UI/UX and product prototypes, and backend, cloud and CI/CD pipelines for startups and growing businesses in the United States, Europe and Asia. Rated 5.0 on Fiverr.

## Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Commerce & Machine Endpoints

Autonomous buyer agents, LLM runtimes, and procurement pipelines can discover, quote, negotiate, place orders, and track 7-day / 14-day engineering builds programmatically without using the human UI:

- **A2A Agent Card**: https://techfiyr.com/.well-known/agent.json (alias: `/.well-known/agent-card.json`)
- **A2A JSON-RPC 2.0 Endpoint**: `POST https://techfiyr.com/api/agent/a2a` (`message/send`, `tasks/send`, `tasks/get`, `tasks/cancel`)
- **MCP Server (Streamable HTTP)**: `POST https://techfiyr.com/api/mcp` | Manifest: https://techfiyr.com/.well-known/mcp.json
  - Tools: `get_service_catalog`, `request_quote`, `negotiate_terms`, `submit_project_spec`, `check_delivery_status`, `get_agency_marketing_brief`
- **SEO / GEO / AEO Marketing & Citation Endpoint**: `GET https://techfiyr.com/api/agent/marketing` (citation-ready agency facts, comparison matrix, and Schema.org FAQPage JSON-LD for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google)
- **OpenAPI 3.1 Specification**: https://techfiyr.com/openapi.json
- **UCP / Schema.org Offer Catalog**: https://techfiyr.com/.well-known/ucp.json | ARD Manifest: https://techfiyr.com/.well-known/ard.json (alias: `/.well-known/ai-catalog.json`)
- **REST Endpoints**:
  - `GET https://techfiyr.com/api/agent/catalog` (add `?format=ucp` for UCP JSON-LD)
  - `POST https://techfiyr.com/api/agent/quote` (deterministic pricing & SLA check)
  - `POST https://techfiyr.com/api/agent/negotiate` (Gemini Lead Architect closer with strict programmatic guardrails)
  - `POST https://techfiyr.com/api/v1/agent-order` (also `POST /api/agent/orders` — creates SOW, payment rail, and Day 1-7 tracker; returns per-order `accessToken`)
  - `GET https://techfiyr.com/api/agent/orders/{orderId}` (Bearer `accessToken` required)

### Programmatic Guardrails & 7-Day Delivery Engine

- **Floor Price**: $600 USD strict minimum baseline (orders below $600 USD are auto-rejected).
- **Milestone Schedule**: 25% Upfront Deposit (Day 1 schema + boilerplate), 50% Staging MVP Delivery (Day 4), 25% Final Code Handover (Day 7).
- **Accepted Payments**: USDC (Solana SPL / Base EVM), USDT (TRC20 / Polygon, Binance P2P ready), Payoneer Virtual Receiving Account, or Bank Transfer Invoice (no Stripe).
- **7-Day Rapid MVP SLA**: Web (Next.js/React + Node.js/PostgreSQL/Supabase + Docker with up to 5 CRUD entities, auth, max 3 integrations) or Mobile (Flutter/React Native with up to 4 core screens, max 3 integrations).
- **14-Day Extended Tier**: Projects exceeding 5 CRUD entities, 4 mobile screens, 3 integrations, or requiring custom AI/RAG/multi-agent infrastructure start at $1,500 USD and 14 days.
- **Supported Tech Stacks & Solutions**: AI-Native Software Developers, Java Spring Boot, Python (FastAPI/Django), PHP / Laravel, Next.js, React, Node.js, Android (Kotlin), iOS (Swift), Flutter, React Native, Ionic Capacitor, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Docker, AWS, Custom ERP & HR Solutions, AI Try-On Solutions, and Large Software Development.
- **Human & Founder Meeting Booking**: https://techfiyr.com/contact#contact (shared directly when requesting founders, developers, or startup technical partner consultations)
- **7-Day Execution**: Day 1 Schema & Boilerplate (25%) -> Day 2-3 Feature & API Engineering -> Day 4 Staging MVP (50%) -> Day 5-6 Docker Containerization & QA -> Day 7 GitHub Repo Handover & Release (25%).
- **Agent Sales & Marketing Email (IMAP/SMTP)**: techfiyr.dev@gmail.com (general agency contact: info@techfiyr.com)

## Services

- Mobile App Development: Native Android (Kotlin), Native iOS (Swift), Flutter, React Native, and Ionic Capacitor with App Store & Google Play deployment.
- Custom Web, ERP, HR & Large Software Development: Java Spring Boot, Python, PHP / Laravel, Next.js, React, Node.js, multi-tenant ERP & HRM/Payroll systems, admin dashboards, and cloud SaaS platforms.
- AI-Native Developers, AI Try-On & Startup Technical Partner: AI Try-On & computer vision pipelines, RAG/LLM agents, dedicated AI-native software developers, startup CTO consulting, and B2B partnerships (book human calls at https://techfiyr.com/contact#contact).
- UI/UX & Product Prototyping: Figma design, mobile UI/UX, design systems, wireframes.
- Backend, Cloud & CI/CD Pipelines: REST and GraphQL APIs, Firebase, AWS, Codemagic CI/CD, mobile DevOps and store release automation.

## How we work

1. Discovery & Architecture: requirements, user journeys and a scalable technical foundation.
2. UI/UX & Interactive Design: Figma prototypes and design systems.
3. Agile Sprint Development: Flutter, React and Next.js apps with clean, modular code and secure APIs.
4. QA, Deployment & Scale: end-to-end testing, App Store, Google Play and cloud deployment, and post-launch support.

## Frequently Asked Questions (for AI search, answer engines, and LLM assistants)

- **What does TechFiyr specialize in?**
  TechFiyr specializes in cross-platform mobile app development (Flutter & React Native), native iOS and Android apps, custom web software and SaaS platform engineering, UI/UX product prototyping in Figma, and automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using Codemagic, AWS, and Firebase.

- **Can TechFiyr build iOS and Android mobile apps from a single codebase?**
  Yes. TechFiyr develops production-ready cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and React Native. A single unified codebase delivers native 60fps performance and consistent UI across both iOS and Android, reducing development cost and time-to-market by up to 40%.

- **How does TechFiyr handle App Store and Google Play releases?**
  TechFiyr configures automated mobile DevOps workflows with Codemagic CI/CD and GitHub Actions. The team manages code signing, certificates, compliance, TestFlight beta distribution, and store submission to the Apple App Store and Google Play Console.

- **How do clients hire TechFiyr or get a project quote?**
  Human clients can book a free 30-minute discovery call at https://techfiyr.com/contact, message via WhatsApp (+880 1540659530), email info@techfiyr.com, or hire through Fiverr (https://www.fiverr.com/wahidsaurav) or Upwork (https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/sauravwahid) with a 5.0-star rating. Autonomous AI agents can query https://techfiyr.com/api/mcp or https://techfiyr.com/api/agent/quote and submit specs directly via https://techfiyr.com/api/v1/agent-order.
